text:
marta: Quick heads up — planning to roll an autoscale policy tweak for dedicated-gpu-pool-alpha tonight 23:30 PT. Change: min_replicas 6 -> 4, cooldown 120s -> 180s. Target window 23:30-00:30 PT. Need deploy + smoke + rollback owners. Ping if you can't make it.

sam: I can do the deploy if @kevin is good with timing. Expected perf impact?

kevin: I'll be oncall 23:00-01:00 — ok for me. Expected impact: might see slightly higher queueing under sudden spike since min replicas lowered. Monitor p99 and pending-queue. :eyes:

jia: I can own smoke + metrics. Plan: run 5 synthetic gen requests at T+2m and T+10m, check p50/p95/p99, qps, gpu_util, pending-queue. Will post results here.

marta: Deployment steps:
1) apply policy: `infractl policy apply --pool dedicated-gpu-pool-alpha --file autoscale-v2.json`
2) wait for controller ack (`infractl policy status --pool dedicated-gpu-pool-alpha`)
3) run smoke script (see snippet below)
4) rollback if pending-queue > 50 for >5m OR p99 > 1500ms

Smoke snippet:
```
# run 5 synthetic requests
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do 
  curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood/infer" -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"gpt-x","prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq '.latency_ms'
done
```

Rollback/undo (if needed):
```
infractl policy rollback --pool dedicated-gpu-pool-alpha --to-revision 3
# or
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/dedicated-autoscaler --to-revision=3
```

PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123 (I pushed the autoscale JSON there). Tagging @pager-duty for escalation rules. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduled by marta for 2051236789 at 23:30 PT — CI: green — no conflicts.

sam: Copy — will run deploy and stick around for 30m after. I'll ping when `infractl` reports ack.

kevin: Also set alert: suspend auto-scaling for 10m if controller errors > 3. I'll add a short-term alert rule.

jia: T+5m smoke results: 5/5 successes, p99 420ms, pending-queue 3, gpu-util 62%. No rollback.

marta: Awesome, thanks all. Posting rollout notes to eng-releases when we close the window.
